name: Automatic Music Transcription Benchmark
description: A benchmark for automatic music transcription: converting polyphonic audio recordings into symbolic musical notation, typically estimating notes, onsets, offsets, pitch, and sometimes velocity.
evaluation_method: Transcription metrics such as precision, recall, F1 for note/onset/offset detection; sometimes frame-based accuracy and note-level F-measure.
notes: Often used to compare model performance on piano and other instrument transcription. Exact protocol varies by subset and metric definitions.
